instruction: You begin facing a bunch of cabinets, moving slightly to the left, take 2 steps forward into the hallway, once you've taken those 2 steps you will see a door in front of you, a door to your left and there will be a hallway to you right, take a step into the hallway to your right, you will see a kitchen once you turn to the right, take 3 steps to move forward through the kitchen, take another step towards the stove top, take 2 more steps forward, going down the kitchen towards the dining area, take one step towards the dining table and then turn to your right, take one step towards the L-shaped couch in the living room, you will see 2 arches, take a step towards the arch that's to the right, it will have a candle holder next to it on the wall, once you're standing in the arch you will see an opened door, to the right of the opened door you will barely be able to see some cabinets, take a step towards those cabinets and then turn to your right, this is a bar area, take a step towards the chair in front of you in the bar area and you're done.
